title: Stellar Vortex Blue

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Suomy Stellar Vortex Blue is tuned for riders carving apexes and commanding fast sweepers, delivering responsive balance and confident road feel. Featuring a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) architecture at 1439g, it combines progressive kinetic energy dissipation across ECE 22.06 certifications with an acoustically tuned ~87 dB aero profile. A plush, washable 3D comfort liner cradles Intermediate Oval head shapes with zero temple pinch for glasses wearers, locked in securely with track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Feature-rich mid-range with double visor and anti-allergic liner.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for oval to intermediate head shapes; features a wide visor opening for enhanced peripheral vision.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Suomy Stellar Vortex Blue: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Suomy Stellar Vortex Blue: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide

introduction: Positioned in Suomy's Full Face lineup, the Stellar Vortex Blue brings Italian engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Suomy Stellar Vortex Blue represents Suomy's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~87 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Suomy Stellar Vortex Blue delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
